prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1010
Claimant:
Stephen Carlson
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
July 23, 2024
Initial report received from the insured driver's policy line describing a left-turn collision at an intersection. The insured
driver is named on the policy and the vehicle was insured at the time of loss.
September 12, 2024
Spoke with the claimant's rperesenting attorney, who confirmed the claimant was seated in the vehicle and reports
neck and back pain following the impact. Requested the medical authorization and the treatment list.
October 10, 2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle and records the other vehicle's involvement. No
independent witnesses are listed, and no one has come forward since.
October 24, 2024
Photos from the scene and the repair shop show damage mostly in line with the described impact. Some details in
the photos confirm the account, while others remain unclear and will need an inspection.
November 16, 2024
Took the claimant's recorded statement through counsel. The account of how the collision occurred matched what
was given in the initial call and in the attorney's first letter.
December 14, 2024
Received the first treatment records. The reported back strain fits the kind and force of the crash, and the early care
followed a usual course.
December 17, 2024
Prior medical history shows a small strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fluly with no ongoing
care. Nothing in the records suggests the current complaint is a continuation of that episode.
January 21, 2025
Checked the vehicle history and found no earlier damage on file for this vehicle. Nothing indicates the damage
predates the start of coverage.
February 6, 2025
Reviewed the later treatment notes, which show the claimant's symptoms tapering off as they improved with care.
The file is being prepared for evaluation of the bodily injury portion of the claim.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
